notes.title: Episode 2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hotfix notes:

 Fixed scenes looping back to PvP / Raids section, preventing progression in the story.


Small fixes:

 Corrected some character faces that were displaying incorrectly in the dialogue box.
 Added missing animation to Scene 63.



Thank you for reporting the issue that caused the game to loop! Scenes should now progress properly all the way to the Episode 2 credits. I hope you can jump back in and finish the episode, and I apologize if this affected your immersion too much.

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Convento is now available in Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863154/3917e4e6e3bd306f81695bf8b58f2010bb6bef53.png

Dive in and get to know the characters and the story. But I'm not done yet, all future episodes will be released for free! And wait, there's more. Hold on, actually no, that's it for now.

Please use the Bugs, Issues and Support Board to report any problems you may find.


Future episodes will be announced and released as soon as possible.

Hope you'll enjoy Convento!
